parts.zh: 一名女子被指控涉嫌违反罗德岛州某市禁止喂食野生动物的法律
新安装的摄像头拍摄到数只老鼠在白天活动
这名女子及其拥有该房产的父母告诉记者
她说:"谁能想到仅仅是喜爱动物就会惹来这么大的麻烦。"
在罗德岛市,禁止喂食包括鸟类在内的任何野生动物
市政管理部门主任Anthony Moretti表示
另一位运动员高藤直寿说:"如果这发生在我身上,我会哭的。我对待自己的金牌非常温柔,不会让它划伤。"
W: 嗯，我读到的研究表明
M: 也许你说得对。我大多数晚上都很晚还在用电脑

items.stem: What do we learn from the report about the 55-year-old woman?

choices.text: She was involved in a conflict with bird lovers.
choices.zh: 她卷入了与爱鸟人士的冲突。

choices.text: She was charged with mistreating animals.
choices.zh: 她被指控虐待动物。

choices.text: She was on bad terms with her neighbors.
choices.zh: 她与邻居关系不睦。

choices.text: She was accused of violating a city law.
choices.zh: 她被指控违反了一项城市法律。

items.stem: What did the director of the city administration say at the end of the news report?

choices.text: It will take time to solve the rat problem.
choices.zh: 解决鼠患问题需要时间。

choices.text: All wild animals should be well protected.
choices.zh: 所有野生动物都应该得到良好保护。

choices.text: The woman was not to blame for the situation.
choices.zh: 这位女性对这种情况不应受到责备。

choices.text: No one should go unpunished for violating law.
choices.zh: 任何人违法都不应逍遥法外。

items.stem: What does NASA require the paid volunteers to do?

choices.text: Communicate with astronauts in Mars Dune Alpha.
choices.zh: 与Mars Dune Alpha中的宇航员交流。

choices.text: Work in an environment resembling Mars.
choices.zh: 在类似火星的环境中工作。

choices.text: Build a Martian habitat in Houston.
choices.zh: 在休斯顿建造火星栖息地。

choices.text: Send in applications before Friday.
choices.zh: 在周五之前提交申请。

items.stem: What will the participants in the project eat?

choices.text: Ready-made food.
choices.zh: 现成的食物。

choices.text: Food that is organic.
choices.zh: 有机食物。

choices.text: Food they grow.
choices.zh: 他们种植的食物。

choices.text: Potatoes mostly.
choices.zh: 主要是土豆。

items.stem: What do the news reports say about the Japanese mayor Takashi Kawamura?

choices.text: He apologized for scratching an athlete's gold medal.
choices.zh: 他为刮花一名运动员的金牌而道歉。

choices.text: He was asked to present a gold medal to Miu Goto.
choices.zh: 他被要求向后藤希友颁发一枚金牌。

choices.text: He bit a softball player's Olympic gold medal.
choices.zh: 他咬了一名垒球运动员的奥运金牌。

choices.text: He attracted public attention at a media event.
choices.zh: 他在一场媒体活动中引起了公众关注。

items.stem: What did mayor Takashi Kawamura offer to do?

choices.text: Have another picture taken with the Olympic medalist.
choices.zh: 与这名奥运奖牌获得者再拍一张照片。

choices.text: Apologize to the International Olympic Committee.
choices.zh: 向国际奥林匹克委员会道歉。

choices.text: Get the damaged medal repaired.
choices.zh: 把损坏的奖牌修好。

choices.text: Pay for the cost of a new medal.
choices.zh: 支付一枚新奖牌的费用。

items.stem: What did some Olympians say they would do with their medals?

choices.text: Allow no one to touch them.
choices.zh: 不允许任何人触碰它们。

choices.text: See them as symbols of honor.
choices.zh: 把它们视为荣誉的象征。

choices.text: Treat them as treasures.
choices.zh: 把它们当作珍宝对待。

choices.text: Keep them in a safe place.
choices.zh: 把它们保存在安全的地方。

items.stem: What did the woman do to her computer?

choices.text: She covered its screen with a plastic sheet.
choices.zh: 她用塑料薄膜覆盖了屏幕。

choices.text: She connected it with her smartphone.
choices.zh: 她把电脑和智能手机连接起来了。

choices.text: She decorated it with colorful stickers.
choices.zh: 她用彩色贴纸装饰了电脑。

choices.text: She bought some new software for it.
choices.zh: 她为电脑购买了一些新软件。

items.stem: What does the woman say about blue light?

choices.text: It may not be simply blue.
choices.zh: 它可能不仅仅是蓝色的。

choices.text: It includes unnatural light.
choices.zh: 它包含非自然光。

choices.text: It is more harmful to young people.
choices.zh: 它对年轻人的危害更大。

choices.text: It induces people to fall asleep.
choices.zh: 它促使人们入睡。

items.stem: Why does the man say he hasn't slept enough for months?

choices.text: He has had much trouble falling asleep.
choices.zh: 他入睡一直很困难。

choices.text: He has had some sort of health problems.
choices.zh: 他有某种健康问题。

choices.text: He has stayed up playing computer games.
choices.zh: 他熬夜玩电脑游戏。

choices.text: He has been burdened with excessive work.
choices.zh: 他承受着过重的工作负担。

items.stem: What has the woman learned from the research she has read?

choices.text: Exposure to blue light is the chief cause of obesity.
choices.zh: 接触蓝光是肥胖的主要原因。

choices.text: Sleep may be more important than people assumed.
choices.zh: 睡眠可能比人们认为的更重要。

choices.text: Sleep may also be negatively affected by natural light.
choices.zh: 睡眠也可能受到自然光的负面影响。

choices.text: Overuse of electronic devices may cause heart disease.
choices.zh: 过度使用电子设备可能导致心脏病。

items.stem: What question were both speakers fed up with when they were kids?

choices.text: What they wanted to be when grown up.
choices.zh: 长大后想成为什么样的人。

choices.text: What their favorite cartoon character was.
choices.zh: 他们最喜欢的卡通角色是什么。

choices.text: What they learned from computer games.
choices.zh: 他们从电脑游戏中学到了什么。

choices.text: What they liked to do most after school.
choices.zh: 他们放学后最喜欢做什么。

items.stem: What occupation do adults see as both sensible and ambitious according to the woman?

choices.text: A stock broker.
choices.zh: 股票经纪人。

choices.text: A pop singer.
choices.zh: 流行歌手。

choices.text: A mechanical engineer.
choices.zh: 机械工程师。

choices.text: A basketball player.
choices.zh: 篮球运动员。

items.stem: What kind of goal-setting does the woman like to see in children?

choices.text: Ambitious.
choices.zh: 有抱负的。

choices.text: Sensible.
choices.zh: 明智的。

choices.text: Imaginative.
choices.zh: 富有想象力的。

choices.text: Practical.
choices.zh: 切合实际的。

items.stem: What does the woman suggest adults should do?

choices.text: Relax their strict control of their kids.
choices.zh: 放松对孩子的严格控制。

choices.text: Help their kids understand themselves.
choices.zh: 帮助孩子了解自己。

choices.text: Impose their own dreams on their kids.
choices.zh: 将自己的梦想强加给孩子。

choices.text: Dismiss their high expectations of their kids.
choices.zh: 放弃对孩子的高期望。

items.stem: What are a number of phone companies trying to do in Africa?

choices.text: Set up company branches.
choices.zh: 建立公司分支机构。

choices.text: Improve its infrastructure.
choices.zh: 改善其基础设施。

choices.text: Introduce iPhones into its markets.
choices.zh: 将iPhone引入其市场。

choices.text: Promote Internet-ready phones.
choices.zh: 推广支持互联网的手机。

items.stem: How do KaiOS smartphones differ from smartphones of most other companies?

choices.text: They cater to Africans' needs.
choices.zh: 它们迎合非洲人的需求。

choices.text: They are more expensive models.
choices.zh: 它们是更昂贵的型号。

choices.text: They are more powerful and capable
choices.zh: 它们更强大且功能更强。

choices.text: They boast the longest battery life.
choices.zh: 它们拥有最长的电池续航时间。

items.stem: What are KaiOS smartphones equipped with?

choices.text: A large touchscreen.
choices.zh: 大型触摸屏。

choices.text: An old-school keypad.
choices.zh: 老式键盘。

choices.text: A voice-response device.
choices.zh: 语音响应设备。

choices.text: A digitally-designed system.
choices.zh: 数字化设计系统。

items.stem: What is said about using recycled plastic to make plastic products in the past?

choices.text: It ensured sustainable economic growth.
choices.zh: 它确保了可持续的经济增长。

choices.text: It was strongly opposed by manufacturers.
choices.zh: 它遭到制造商的强烈反对。

choices.text: It was cheaper than using fossil fuel plastic.
choices.zh: 它比使用化石燃料塑料更便宜。

choices.text: It satisfied consumer demands on the whole.
choices.zh: 它总体上满足了消费者的需求。

items.stem: What has led to more competitive price for new plastic?

choices.text: The capacity to mass produce it.
choices.zh: 大规模生产的能力。

choices.text: The U.S. federal government's regulations.
choices.zh: 美国联邦政府的法规。

choices.text: A boom in market demand for clear plastic bottles.
choices.zh: 透明塑料瓶市场需求的繁荣。

choices.text: A rapid increase in U.S. petroleum chemical production.
choices.zh: 美国石油化工产量的快速增长。

items.stem: What does the UK government plan to do about plastic?

choices.text: Require companies to use 30% of new plastic.
choices.zh: 要求企业使用30%的新塑料。

choices.text: Increase the supply of new plastic in the market.
choices.zh: 增加市场上新塑料的供应。

choices.text: Reduce the amount of plastic pollution in local areas.
choices.zh: 减少当地地区的塑料污染量。

choices.text: Take measures to promote the use of recycled plastic.
choices.zh: 采取措施促进回收塑料的使用。

items.stem: What do we learn about the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan?

choices.text: It studies dreams.
choices.zh: 它研究梦境。

choices.text: It rents a place for nap-takers.
choices.zh: 它为午睡者出租场地。

choices.text: It is a hotel for business people.
choices.zh: 它是一家为商务人士服务的酒店。

choices.text: It is a nap research institute.
choices.zh: 它是一家午睡研究机构。

items.stem: Why does the speaker ask us to look at the world around us at 2:30 in the afternoon?

choices.text: To find out creative people's work performance.
choices.zh: 为了了解有创造力的人的工作表现。

choices.text: To see how many people can go without napping.
choices.zh: 为了看看有多少人可以不午睡。

choices.text: To understand the obvious importance of napping.
choices.zh: 为了理解午睡的明显重要性。

choices.text: To feel how difficult it is to get his idea across.
choices.zh: 为了感受让别人理解他的想法有多困难。

items.stem: What do we learn about the quantity and quality of the speaker's work?

choices.text: They decline due to pointless meetings.
choices.zh: 它们因无意义的会议而下降。

choices.text: They depend on his ability to concentrate.
choices.zh: 它们取决于他的专注能力。

choices.text: They enable him to enjoy a creative career.
choices.zh: 它们使他能够享受创造性的职业生涯。

choices.text: They are affected by the overuse of social media.
choices.zh: 它们受到社交媒体过度使用的影响。

items.stem: What does the speaker say he finds odd?

choices.text: Some bosses associate napping with laziness.
choices.zh: 一些老板把午睡与懒惰联系在一起。

choices.text: Many office workers nap during work hours.
choices.zh: 许多办公室职员在工作时间午睡。

choices.text: Some bosses can concentrate without napping.
choices.zh: 一些老板可以不午睡就能集中注意力。

choices.text: Many of his friends daydream in the office.
choices.zh: 他的许多朋友在办公室里做白日梦。
